text:
sam_sales: Acme wants an isolated POC. They asked whether PrivateLink-only is sufficient or if we need TGW for data plane. Also asked for a one-pager of "what we need from them" for fast provisioning.

maya_se: Short answer: PrivateLink-only is fine for control-plane and most API traffic. TGW is only needed if they must route traffic into our dedicated infra-level VPCs or want to centralize many account attachments.

trent_neteng: Minimal PrivateLink checklist from network side:
- Confirm their VPC CIDR (no overlap with our infra 10.230.0.0/16).
- Provide 1 private subnet per AZ for interface endpoints (we recommend /24 minimum).
- Create interface endpoint(s) using our service name; send VPCE IDs to us for acceptance.
- Ensure endpoint subnets have free IPs (avoid /28s).
- Security group on endpoint: allow inbound TCP/443 from app subnets, outbound TCP/443 to our control-plane CIDRs.

faye_sre: Security & DNS notes:
- Enable Private DNS on the VPCE or create Route53 records in their private hosted zone pointing to ENI IPs. Private DNS is easier but can affect split-horizon setups.
- If they have host/header-rewriting proxies, ask them to run a curl from an EC2 inside the VPC and paste output. That helps debug SNI/Host mismatches.
- Tag their resources with `redwood:poc=acme` so SRE can find them quickly.

maya_se: IAM/TGW note if they later pivot to TGW:
- They should create a cross-account role allowing `ec2:CreateTransitGatewayVpcAttachment` and `ec2:AcceptTransitGatewayVpcAttachment` and share the role ARN.
- For TGW attachments we will provide the TGW ID and accept; they must then add static routes or enable propagation (we prefer static for POCs).

sam_sales: Ops question: what minimal egress ACL list do they need if their corp firewall blocks outbound?

trent_neteng: Provide these minimal egress CIDRs (placeholder): `34.200.1.0/24, 34.200.2.0/24` and ports TCP/443, TCP/8200 (if Vault/agent is used). We'll send the exact ranges after environment prep.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Created POC task POC-3001. Please attach VPCE IDs and subnet IDs as comments.

faye_sre: Quick curl test for customer to run after VPCE acceptance:
```
curl -v --resolve api.redwood.internal:443:10.1.5.11 https://api.redwood.internal/health
```
Replace IP with the ENI private IP.

maya_se: Pricing/ops note for sales: Dedicated-managed reserved pool is lower friction for short trials (we handle infra) but if customer requires full control or on-prem-like isolation they may choose Private deployment which involves infra and license costs. I'll loop in sales-ops for numbers.

sam_sales: Great, I'll bundle this into a one-pager and send. Will post VPCE IDs and their preferred pricing model when Acme replies. Thanks.
